settings.heading: Returns & refunds
settings.intro: We want you to feel good about your purchase. Here’s how to get help if something isn’t right.
settings.content:
Contact us first

For return or refund requests, please contact us with your order number and details of the issue before sending any item back.

Eligibility and timing

Return eligibility, time limits, item condition requirements, and available remedies depend on our actual store policy and applicable requirements. Add your verified terms here before publishing.

Refunds

Approved refunds are processed using the method and timing available for your order. We will confirm the details with you directly.
